title: Tech Note: Modifying Resources with 4th Dimension

historical_commentary.text: This note demonstrates programmatic resource modification in 4D v6, replacing the need for external tools like ResEdit or Resorcerer. It includes sample databases for changing flush buffer characters and localizing databases. The resource fork-based approach is entirely obsolete on modern systems — macOS dropped resource fork support for applications long ago, and modern 4D uses XLIFF files and built-in localization mechanisms instead of STR# resource modification.
related_updates: Resource forks are no longer used in modern macOS or 4D applications
4D now uses XLIFF files for localization instead of STR# resource manipulation
ResEdit and Resorcerer are discontinued classic Mac OS tools
